declare
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_rec_no VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_rec_count number;
 cursor c1 is
 select distinct unit_id, coll_date,
 chapter_id, tb_seq_no, 'x',
 test_chapter_id
 from holding_tests
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and result_status_1 is null 
 and holding_status is null
 order by tb_seq_no;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 temp_rec_count := 0;
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_sl_no := c1_rec.tb_seq_no;
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id := c1_rec.chapter_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_flag := 'Y';
 :ctrl_blk_2.test_chapter_id := c1_rec.test_chapter_id;
 :chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:CTRL_BLK_2.unit_id,:CTRL_BLK_2.coll_date,:CTRL_BLK_2.chapter_id);
 down;
 end loop;
 synchronize; 
 if :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id is null then
 clear_record;
 end if;
 first_record;
 --message put in cause otherwise the cursor for some strange reason moves to the 2nd record 
 message(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item,hint_text),no_acknowledge);
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_rec_no VARCHAR2(3);
 temp_x varchar2(1);
begin
 nullchk;
 /* Validate if units are actually pending for the given worksheet */
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :s_pending_units
 from holding_tests
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and result_status_1 is null
 and holding_status is null
 and exists
 (select 'x'
 from test_batch_det, valid_tests
 where holding_tests.test_id = valid_tests.test_id
 and holding_tests.tb_id = test_batch_det.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_group in
 (select code from master_codes 
 where code_type = 'ANTGR'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate))
 and test_type = 'M'
 and testing_lab_code = :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code
 and reconcile_date is null);
 if :s_pending_units = 0
 then
 show_error('1233');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 /* validate reagents have been entered for all the antigen tests */
 begin
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM test_batch_det 
 WHERE tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND test_kit_id is null
 AND rownum = 1;
 show_error('9313');
 exception
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 end;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: MOVE_HOLDINGTESTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE move_holdingtests IS
 temp_count number(6):= 0;
BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) INTO temp_count
 FROM test_batch_det tbd
 WHERE tb_id = :GLOBAL.tb_id 
 AND test_id in 
 (SELECT test_id from valid_tests 
 WHERE test_group in 
 (SELECT code FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'ANTGR'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate))
 )
 AND nvl(reconcile_flag,'N') != 'Y';
 IF temp_count = 0 THEN
 DECLARE
 cursor c1 is
 SELECT distinct test_id 
 FROM holding_tests
 WHERE tb_id = :GLOBAL.tb_id 
 AND test_id IN 
 (SELECT test_id from valid_tests 
 WHERE test_group in 
 (SELECT code FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'ANTGR'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate))
 )
 AND holding_status is null;
 BEGIN 
 for rec in C1
 loop
 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'x' 
 INTO :GLOBAL.x 
 FROM test_batch_parms
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND tb_id = :GLOBAL.tb_id 
 AND test_id = rec.test_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 DECLARE
 tresult varchar2(80); 
 BEGIN
 tresult := sbclib.move_holding_tests(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 rec.test_id,
 :GLOBAL.tb_id,
 null,
 :banner.prog_name);
 IF nvl(tresult, 'null') != '0' THEN
 show_error('3106', tresult);
 END IF;
 END;
 END;
 end loop;
 END; 
 END IF;
 erase(:GLOBAL.tb_id);
 clear_message;
EXCEPTION
 when others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PERFORM_COMMIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE perform_commit IS
BEGIN
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 /* Update reconcile flag on completed batches */
 UPDATE test_batch_det tbd
 SET reconcile_date = sysdate, reconcile_flag = 'Y'
 WHERE tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id 
 AND test_id in 
 (SELECT test_id from valid_tests 
 WHERE test_group in 
 (SELECT code FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'ANTGR'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate))
 )
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND 0 = (SELECT count(*) 
 FROM holding_tests
 WHERE tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 AND test_id = tbd.test_id
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND result_status_1 is null);
 /* Update Result_dats */
 :GLOBAL.tb_id := :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id;
 UPDATE holding_tests 
 SET result_dats = sysdate
 WHERE tb_id = :GLOBAL.tb_id 
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND result_status_1 is not null 
 AND test_id in 
 (SELECT test_id from valid_tests 
 WHERE test_group in 
 (SELECT code FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'ANTGR'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate))
 )
 AND result_dats is null; :system.message_level := 10;
 :system.message_level := 10;
 -- commit_form;
 IF not form_success THEN
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('0230');
 ELSE
 move_holdingtests;
 commit;
 IF not form_success THEN
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('0230');
 ELSE
 :system.message_level := 0;
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 show_error('0000');
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 clear_message;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLOSE_WORKSHEET
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE close_worksheet IS
begin
 UPDATE holding_tests 
 SET result_status_1 = 'NT',
 result_user_id = :banner.user_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name,
 result_dats = sysdate 
 WHERE tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id 
 AND test_id in 
 (SELECT test_id FROM valid_tests
 WHERE test_group in 
 (SELECT code FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'ANTGR'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)))
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND result_status_1 is null;
 perform_commit;
end;
